pins.definition: Having very little weight; not heavy.
Having little physical weight; not heavy.

situation: A person is lifting a large, oversized cardboard box with one finger to impress a friend.
subject: the lightness of the box
brief: A man stands in a living room, grinning as he balances a huge, towering shipping box on the tip of his extended index finger. The box is clearly empty and made of thin corrugated paper, as evidenced by a corner that has peeled back to show the hollow interior. His friend stands to the side, looking at the floating box with an expression of comical bewilderment.
